templates: The city where {} was born is
The primary language in which {} wrote is
spec.instruction: Famous deceased novelists, poets, playwrights. Birthplace must be a city/town with a well-established English name. Writing language must be a single clearly primary language; exclude famous multilingual authors. Mix continents, eras, genders; at least half not English-language. Use primary literary language, not nationality or guessed native language.
